title: Supplier Quality Assurance Engineer

* Supplier Selection and Qualification: Evaluate and select suppliers based on quality, cost, and delivery performance.
* Quality Assurance: Develop and implement quality control processes to ensure suppliers meet quality standards.

title: Sr. Quality Assurance Engineer
description:
Vacancy Intro
  
  
Haskoning is an independent consulting engineering company that is dedicated to creating a positive impact on people and planet. Backed by the expertise of over 6,000 colleagues working from offices in more than 20 countries, and with more than 140 years of experience under our belt, we are helping clients with challenges ranging from climate change and digital transformation to changing customer demands and the energy transition. Driven by our mission Enhancing Society Together, we believe that each and every one of us holds the power to deliver measurable positive impact on society through our projects, and in our own operations
  
  
What will you do
  
  

* Review and monitor the Quality Management System, Quality Plans, ITPs, Method Statements, and QA/QC procedures being implemented by EPC Contractors.
* Conduct site inspections and quality surveillance to ensure compliance with approved drawings, specifications, standards, and contract requirements by EPC Contractors.
* Review and recommend approval of materials, suppliers, manufacturers, and subcontractor quality submissions to be used on the project.
* Witness and verify field and laboratory testing activities of EPC Contractors, ensuring compliance with approved testing standards and frequencies. Audit EPC Contractors’ processes, quality records, and implementation of quality management procedures.
* Participate in quality review meetings and resolve technical issues.
* Provide guidance for concrete quality issues, material substitutions and construction methodology improvements at the site.
* Review EPC Contractors’ quality-related submissions, including material approvals, method statements, inspection test plans (ITPs), test reports, shop drawings, quality plans, and as-built documentation.
* Coordinate with contractors, consultants, laboratories, proof consultants, and client representatives on quality matters.
* Identify quality deficiencies, issue observations/NCRs, and monitor implementation of corrective and preventive actions. Prepare quality surveillance reports, audit reports, NCR tracking reports, quality performance reports, and compliance assessments.
* Monitor quality compliance during commissioning, project completion, handover, and defect rectification stages.
* Advise the Client on quality risks, non-conformities, and acceptance or rejection of works.
* Ensure all infrastructure works, including roads, utilities, water supply, sewerage, drainage, STP/CETP, electrical systems, and associated facilities, meet the specified quality standards and long-term performance requirements.

Where you will work
  
  
Roha, Raigad.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Qualification & Skills Requirement**

* B.E. / B. Tech in Civil Engineering
* Certifications such as ISO 9001 Lead Auditor
* Strong knowledge of international codes and standards (e.g., ASTM, ACI, BS, IS codes).
* Good report writing skills.
* Good communication skills in English and Hindi.

**Experience Requirement**

* Minimum 15 years of professional experience with a minimum of 8 years in QA/QC for Civil Construction Work.
* Hands-on experience in supervising and verifying contractor adherence to QA/QC procedures for critical activities such as concrete pouring & cube testing, earthwork compaction & field density tests, and structural/finishing works.
* Exposure to ISO 9001 quality management systems and auditing practices.
* Experience in coordinating with contractors and consultants to ensure documentation accuracy and adherence to project quality plans.

What we offer you
  
  

* Market competitive salary
* Experience in an employee friendly work culture
* Insurance cover for self and family
* Social Security
* Paid leaves
* Group Profit Sharing

Are you our new colleague?
  
  
We would like to meet you! Click on the apply button and upload your resume and motivation letter. After receiving your application, we will contact you as soon as possible. The application process then consists of 1-2 interviews and a possibly assessment. Are we all enthusiastic after this? Then you will receive an offer from us, and we will be happy to welcome you on board!
  
  
For more information, you can always contact Imran Khan, at imran.khan@haskoning.com.

title: Junior Engineer II, Process quality
description:

 We’re a global, multi\-disciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. At HARMAN Automotive, we give you the keys to fast\-track your career.
   

  

* Engineer audio systems and integrated technology platforms that augment the driving experience
* Combine ingenuity, in\-depth research, and a spirit of collaboration with design and engineering excellence
* Advance in\-vehicle infotainment, safety, efficiency, and enjoyment


**What You’ll Be Part Of**
* The Process Quality Engineer (PQE) will be responsible for ensuring the consistent quality of speaker manufacturing processes through robust process control like First article Inspections, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. The PQE will work closely with cross\-functional teams including production, design, and supplier quality to maintain and improve product quality and customer satisfaction. Also responsible for QMS documentation and customer audits


**How You’ll Make An Impact**
* Develop and implement process control plans and PFMEAs for Speaker assembly and testing processes.
* Monitor key process parameters and quality metrics to ensure compliance with internal and customer specifications.
* Lead root cause analysis and implement corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for process\-related quality issues.
* Prepare Product audit, Layout audit \& Dock audit as per plan
* Conduct process audits, layered process audits (LPA), and product audits to ensure adherence to standards.
* Collaborate with design and manufacturing teams to improve acoustic performance, cosmetic quality, and durability of speaker products.
* Interact with overseas teams to Implement the Robust process controls
* Interface with suppliers and customers on quality\-related topics as needed.
* Maintain documentation in line with IATF 16949, ISO 9001, and customer\-specific requirements.


**What Makes You A Strong Fit**
* Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Electronics, or Speaker Manufacturing field.
* 3\+ years of experience in process quality or manufacturing quality, preferably in audio electronics or Speaker Manufacturing process
* Strong knowledge of quality tools: 8D, 5 Why, Fishbone, SPC, MSA, FMEA, Control Plans.
* Experience with speaker assembly processes (e.g., diaphragm bonding, magnet assembly, acoustic testing) is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with measurement systems such as sound analyzers, impedance testers, and visual inspection systems.
* Proficient in MS Office, Handling of Profile Projectors, and Universal testing machines.
* Excellent communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills.


**Things To Know**
* Successfully complete a background investigation and drug screen as a condition of employment
* This position requires the use of a HARMAN or customer\-owned vehicle. As such, any offer of employment will be contingent upon having a clean driving record, which will be evaluated and determined in HARMAN’s sole discretion

* A hybrid work environment that balances flexibility with in\-person collaboration, with most office\-based roles onsite three days a week.
* Access to employee discounts on HARMAN and Samsung products (including JBL, Harman / Kardon, AKG, and others)
* Learning and development opportunities through our award\-winning HARMAN University programs
* Wellness benefits designed to support your overall well\-being
* Tuition reimbursement support
* Access to the HARMAN campus fitness center and cafeteria, where available
* An inclusive and diverse work environment that supports both your professional and personal development

 HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support\-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

 Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.
   

  

 Across automotive, lifestyle, and digital transformation solutions, we create innovative technologies that turn ordinary moments into extraordinary experiences. Our renowned automotive and lifestyle solutions can be found everywhere, from the music we play in our cars and homes to venues that feature today’s most sought\-after performers, while our digital transformation solutions serve humanity by addressing the world’s ever\-evolving needs and demands. **Job Description Summary**

* Ensure that monitoring of production line and periodic Quality Control checks are being carried out on regularly in order to help production department to reduce the In\-Process rejection.

* Analyze, validate, and investigate returned products to identify root causes of failures, ultimately reducing warranty costs and improving product reliability.
* To create and maintain documentations such as quality manuals and quality procedures.
